trace.question: Can a lead give a regular 25% off a catering order?
trace.answer:
No. A lead can't approve a 25% discount on its own. Discounts above 10% need a lead, but any discount above 20% needs the owner [House Policy §4, Discounts]. The policies don't set a separate catering discount rule, so this limit applies to catering orders too.

Catering orders over $300 also need the owner's confirmation [House Policy §6, Catering]. So a 25% discount needs the owner's approval, and the owner must also confirm the order if it is over $300. A lead can approve a discount of up to 20%. Seasonal Specials can never be discounted, so they would have to stay at full price on the order [House Policy §4, Discounts].
